settings.heading: DESCRIPTION
settings.content:
FreshWipes Start The Routine Kit

Plaque builds up every day and can lead to bad breath, gum irritation, and costly dental treatments. FreshWipes gently lift away plaque and bacteria with a simple finger wipe, helping support cleaner teeth, fresher breath, and healthier gums in just seconds.

EyeWipes Start The Routine Kit

Tear stains and moisture around the eyes can create the perfect environment for irritation and buildup. EyeWipes gently remove dirt, discharge, and staining while helping keep the eye area clean, comfortable, and healthy.

Fresh Breath in 30 Days Ebook + Routine Tracker

A step-by-step system designed to help you build a consistent dental care routine for your pet. Includes practical guidance, progress tracking, and simple daily actions to support fresher breath and healthier teeth.

Tear Stain Comb

Designed to safely lift away dried discharge, debris, and tear stain buildup around the eyes. The fine-tooth design helps keep the eye area clean while making grooming easier and more effective.

Complete Eye Care System

A complete eye health guide with an easy-to-follow routine tracker. Learn how to maintain cleaner eyes, reduce tear stains, and build healthy grooming habits that support long-term eye comfort.
